subject: social_studies
concept: Understanding how migration and movement of people has historically shaped the cultural mix of many communities
source_inspiration: original content — not sourced from any external text

exercise.pictorial: Student traces a described group's movement on a map and matches it to the cultural elements they brought with them
exercise.abstract: Student explains how a described community's culture reflects the movement of people into it over time

misconception_flags: believes a community's culture has always been exactly the same with no historical change or outside influence

interest_binding: exercise regenerated using student's stated interest profile
